Pursuant to the said order dated 30.4.2014, the applicant appeared before the Court and has been granted bail.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that proceedings initiated against the applicant is without any basis and only because some harmful substance has been found in the sample,
proceedings under the Food Safety and Standards Act cannot be drawn against him.

Per contra, learned AGA has submitted that on the basis of sample report submitted by the designated officer, the proceedings has rightly been initiated against the applicant and there is no illegality in the said order.

Moreover, the present application has been filed with the delay of more than six years and there is no explanation for the laches in filing the present application and as such,
no interference is required.

Having considered the rival submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the fact that on the basis of sample report submitted by the designated officer,
wherein sample has been found harmful for human consumption, proceedings under the Food Safety and Standards Act has rightly been initiated against the applicant. Moreover, there is no proper explanation for delay in filing the present application and as such, no interference is required to be made by this Court at this stage.
In case the applicant moves an application for discharge at appropriate stage, the same shall be considered and disposed of in accordance with law.
With these observations, the present application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of.
